forecast: 2023 medians by city, calendar month, UTC half-hour and weekday/weekend; no online historical actuals are fed to forecast
arrivals: Known to planner only at or after recorded start; declared energy and window equal the recorded quantities in the replay. Arrivals between decisions use immediate charging until next decision.
service: Preserve immediate-charging readiness at the early checkpoint and deliver recorded energy by proxy end for every session.
cost_control: Forecast carbon controller cap equals cost of the feasible carry-forward plan plus new active sessions charged immediately. Realized cost is evaluated separately against a common historical ASAP grid-only ceiling.
terminal_storage: Every plan returns to 50 percent state of charge by its horizon end. The common study-week end truncates the horizon.
